example.interpretation: Aspects in the 5th harmonic chart become quintile aspects in the natal chart

steps: Convert all planetary longitudes to decimal degrees (0-360).
Multiply each longitude by the harmonic number H.
If result ≥ 360°, subtract 360° repeatedly until result is between 0° and 360°.
Plot new positions on a 360° wheel (standard or 90° dial).
Identify conjunctions (≤ 1° orb) – these are the harmonic aspects.

python_code.function: def calculate_harmonic_chart(positions, H): return [(pos * H) % 360 for pos in positions]
